final_message:
I implemented `parsePorts`, `normalizePorts`, and `countPorts` in `src/ports.ts` following the README. All three tests in `tests/ports.test.ts` pass with `npm test`.

Parsing rejects empty items, non-digit text, ports outside 1-65535, and ranges whose end is below their start. Overlapping and touching ranges are merged. I also checked the README examples and the error cases by hand. I didn't run a typecheck because `tsc` isn't installed and npx couldn't fetch it. Nothing is committed.
